email.subject1: a signal play for Dominion DMS
email.body1:
Matt, saw Dominion DMS push the cloud-based VUE platform on Azure and the new Gather integration.

A cloud-native launch opens more in-market dealerships than a regional team can cover before you can hire and ramp, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Dominion DMS off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matt, quick follow-up for Dominion DMS.

As VUE rolls out region by region, the target list grows faster than the team does, and most groups cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number. So the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Dominion needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matt, last bit of proof for Dominion DMS.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dominion's reply rate likely compares to other dealer software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matt, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Driving a regional rollout of a new cloud platform is its own kind of busy and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Dominion either way.
